title: The Purest Form of Love
content:
The cool breeze gently swept across the open square beneath the Eiffel Tower.

For a few moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Shreya lowered her eyes, gathering the courage she had been searching for all evening.

Finally...

She looked up at Yagnesh.

"Yagnesh..."

"I don't know how to say this..."

"But ever since we met..."

"I've been feeling something I can't explain."

Yagnesh listened quietly.

She took a slow, nervous breath.

"I like the way you care about people."

"I like the respect you show everyone."

"And..."

"You were the first person who apologized after hurting me."

A faint smile appeared on her face.

"Do you know how much that meant to me?"

Yagnesh remained silent.

His eyes never left hers.

Shreya continued softly.

"After what I did to Siddu..."

"I've often felt that I no longer deserved to ask someone to love me."

"The world remembers me as the girl who betrayed him."

"And honestly..."

"I don't blame them."

Her eyes slowly filled with tears.

"But I'm not that person anymore."

"I've learned from my mistakes."

"I've changed."

"And today..."

"I don't want to hide behind my past anymore."

She slowly stepped closer.

"If you give me one chance..."

"I promise..."

"I'll show you the purest form of love."

She looked directly into his eyes.

"I love you, Yagnesh."

Silence.

The bustling streets of Paris...

The glowing lights...

The voices of countless strangers...

Everything around them disappeared.

Only the two of them remained.

Yagnesh had imagined confessing first countless times.

But hearing those words from Shreya...

Left him completely speechless.

His heart raced.

His thoughts disappeared.

A smile slowly spread across his face.

Then...

Without thinking any further...

The words hidden inside his heart escaped on their own.

"I love you too."

The moment Shreya heard those four words...

Her eyes sparkled with happiness.

A tear rolled gently down her cheek.

Not a tear of sorrow...

But one of relief.

A genuine smile bloomed across her face.

One free from guilt.

One free from regret.

Slowly...

She stepped closer.

Their eyes remained locked.

The golden lights of the Eiffel Tower shimmered behind them.

The cool breeze danced gently around them.

For a brief moment...

Their foreheads rested against each other.

Neither of them spoke.

Words were no longer necessary.

Their hearts had already said everything.

Then...

As if destiny itself had brought them together...

They shared a soft, gentle kiss.

It lasted only a few seconds.

Yet...

For both of them...

Time itself seemed to stop.

When they slowly pulled apart...

Neither knew what to say.

Shreya's cheeks turned bright red.

She covered her face shyly and laughed softly.

"I..."

"I should leave now."

Before Yagnesh could reply...

She hurried away into the crowd.

Yagnesh remained standing there, completely frozen.

His first love.

His first confession.

His very first kiss.

All had happened on the same unforgettable night beneath the lights of Paris.

Only after several minutes did he finally regain his senses.

A smile spread across his face as he slowly made his way back to the hotel.

________________________________________

Even after reaching his room...

His heart refused to calm down.

Every moment of the evening replayed inside his mind.

Her smile.

Her confession.

The kiss.

Just then...

Someone knocked on the door.

Yagnesh quickly opened it.

Sneha stood outside.

"There you are."

"Where did you disappear?"

Yagnesh tried his best to sound normal.

"I... went to see the Eiffel Tower."

Sneha smiled.

"Alright."

"It's getting late."

"Go get some sleep."

She turned to leave.

"Wait..."

Yagnesh called out.

Sneha turned back.

"What happened?"

He smiled nervously.

"Sneha..."

"Ever since we became friends..."

"We've never hidden anything from each other."

"So..."

"I want to tell you something."

Sneha walked back inside the room.

"I'm listening."

Yagnesh scratched the back of his head.

Then...

With the happiest smile Sneha had ever seen on his face...

He said,

"Shreya proposed to me."

Sneha's eyes widened.

"What?!"

Yagnesh laughed and told her everything.

From meeting Shreya beneath the Eiffel Tower...

To exploring Paris together...

Watching anime with a shared pair of earbuds...

Having dinner together...

Her confession...

And finally...

Their first kiss.

By the time he finished...

Sneha couldn't stop smiling.

"I'm really happy for both of you."

Then suddenly...

She paused.

A mischievous smile appeared on her face.

"Wait a minute..."

"Isn't Shreya two years older than you?"

Yagnesh laughed.

"So what?"

"Two years don't matter to me."

"What matters is how someone treats you."

"Respect..."

"Trust..."

"Understanding..."

"And the affection two hearts have for each other."

"That's what makes love beautiful."

Sneha folded her arms and grinned.

"Oh..."

"So our Yagnesh has become quite the philosopher after falling in love."

Yagnesh rubbed the back of his head, laughing in embarrassment.

Sneha continued teasing him for several more minutes.

Their laughter echoed through the quiet hotel corridor.

For the first time in a long while...

The future no longer felt uncertain.

Somewhere beneath the same night sky...

Two love stories...

Were finally beginning.
